[中文](#cn-v0.3.0) | [English](#en-v0.3.0)

**能读原型的样式了。** 以前只有"设计稿"那条路能拿到色值/字号/坐标；现在 **Axure 原型页面**也能读出**同样形状**的块级清单 ——
**没有设计稿、只有原型的项目，也能照着实现**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.3.0">新增功能</h3>

- **原型页面样式读取**：`lanhu_read_product_doc` 新增 `format`（CLI 同名 `--format layers`），
  输出该页的**图层/块级清单**：绝对坐标、尺寸、圆角、底色、文字色、字号、字重、字体族、行高、透明度、描边、渐变 stop、切图、层级。
- **与设计稿是同一张表** —— 六项属性 + 文字色 + 字体族 + 行高字距，AI 不用学第二套；
  下游 `collectTokens` / `classifyBlock` / `renderRegion` **全部直接复用**。
- **动态面板的备选状态也会读出来**：实测一份稿有 7 个面板 / 179 层状态图挂在 `diagrams[].objects[]` 里
  （日历的 August/July/June 各 41 层）。输出带 `panelState` / `panelOf`，
  并显式提醒「**它们是互斥的备选状态，不是同时显示的层**」—— 因为导出里**没有"当前是哪个状态"的字段**。
- **结构审计（每次运行都跑）**：统计文档里**实际出现的子层键**与遍历器**真正走过的键**，
  有"文档里有、但没走"的键 → 进 `stats.unknownChildKeys` 并打 ❌ 警告，**清单不完整这件事不会被静默**。
  同时守住 `Axure:PanelDiagram` 那条排除规则（文档里几个 == 经 `diagrams` 走到几个）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.3.0">体验优化</h3>

- 实测某原型页 **670 个控件 / 337 块**，色板与字号统计与设计稿同格式输出。
- 缺字号时**留 `?` 并写明"别读成 0、也别猜"** —— 那份导出里 74 个文本层确实没有字号，
  外链 CSS 只能给 `.ax_default{13px}` 这种通用兜底，**用它算编造**，所以不给。

<h3 id="cn-v0.3.0">问题修复</h3>

- **`argbColor` 把透明当不透明**：旧启发式 `a === 0 ? 1 : …` 会把 `0x00FFFFFF` 读成不透明白色。
  实测 129 个样本零不一致地证明**高字节就是 alpha**（`0x7f58a2cc` ↔ `opacity 0.4980392156862745`，127/255 精确相等）。
  它此前**没有调用点**，所以一直没出事。
- **两类子层被静默漏掉，共 52 层**：
  ① **状态容器自己**（`Axure:PanelDiagram`）—— 它没有 `location`/`size`，被"无几何不算层"排除，
  但实测同一面板三个状态的**底色各不相同**，等于丢了状态背景；
  ② **中继器 / 表格的子层** —— 它们挂在 `objects[]`，**不是 `objs[]`**，旧遍历器根本没走这个键。
  现在 670 == 670、逐 id 双向零差。
- **`axureScriptIds` 传错入参静默返回空 Map**（调用方会以为"这稿没有"）：现在形状不对就**明确抛错**并给出正确用法。
- **拿设计稿链接问产品文档时，报错先判"它是不是设计稿"**并指路（见 0.2.1）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.3.0">其他变更</h3>

- 自检 **459 → 530 项**，新增断言全部为**合成夹具**（**没有把 862 KB 真实导出提交进仓库**）；
  变异测试证明绊线会红：去掉任一子层键 → 7 / 14 / 13 条红；把审计失效 → 5 条红。
- **`lanhu_verify_blocks` 暂不接原型页**：这份原型对应的前端还没实现，接了就是**无任何真机证据的代码**；
  且原型画布（1928×2962 绝对坐标、非响应式）与被测页面**不是同一坐标空间**，硬接会拿不可比的东西去比。
  建议等页面做出来再按**文本内容**对齐（原型文本已能取到，是最可靠的锚点）。
- **试过并删掉的一个方案**：用外链 CSS 补那 74 个缺失字号。实测 251 条 `#uNNN{font-size}`
  **全部落在本来就有字号的控件上**（说明 CSS 是从 `data.js` 生成的，不带新信息）→ **零收益，代码已移除**。
- **叙事文档补齐**：README（开篇 / 30 秒上手 / 它能做什么 / 英文总览）、`docs/产品文档.md`（新增「这一页的样式也能读」）、
  `docs/读稿.md` / `docs/验收.md`（写清**为什么暂不接原型页**）/ `docs/CLI与开发.md` 都补上了新能力的说明与边界。
- **政策：自指的项数不写进散文** —— 绊线能守"selfcheck 有几项"，但守不住"绊线自己有几项"（它只有跑完才知道）。
  所以散文里改为说明"它守什么"，并加了一条**不许再写死它**的断言。
- 思路仍吸收自社区项目 [`dsphper/lanhu-mcp`](https://github.com/dsphper/lanhu-mcp)（MIT），**独立实现**。

**Full Changelog**: [v0.2.1...v0.3.0](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.2.1...v0.3.0)

---

<h3 id="en-v0.3.0">New Features</h3>

**The plugin can now read styles out of prototypes.** Until now only design artboards yielded colours, font sizes and
coordinates; **Axure prototype pages** now produce the **same shape** of block list — so a project with **no design
artboards at all** can still be implemented from.

- **Prototype page styles**: `lanhu_read_product_doc` gained a `format` option (CLI: `--format layers`) that emits the
  page's layer/block list: absolute coordinates, size, corner radius, fill, text colour, font size, weight, family,
  line height, opacity, borders, gradient stops, slices and hierarchy.
- **Same table as design artboards** — six properties plus text colour, font family and line height, so an AI does not
  have to learn a second format. Downstream `collectTokens` / `classifyBlock` / `renderRegion` are reused as-is.
- **Dynamic panel states are read too**: one real document hid 7 panels / 179 state layers inside
  `diagrams[].objects[]` (the calendar's August/July/June, 41 layers each). Output carries `panelState` / `panelOf` and
  states plainly that **these are mutually exclusive alternatives, not simultaneously visible layers** — the export
  has **no field saying which state is current**.
- **Structural audit (runs every time)**: it compares the child-layer keys **present in the document** with those the
  walker **actually follows**, puts anything missed into `stats.unknownChildKeys` and prints a ❌ warning, so an
  incomplete list is **never silent**. It also guards the `Axure:PanelDiagram` exclusion rule.

<h3 id="en-v0.3.0">Improvements</h3>

- A real prototype page yields **670 widgets / 337 blocks**, with colour and font-size statistics in the same format as
  design artboards.
- A missing font size stays `?` with an explicit note not to read it as 0 and not to guess: those 74 text layers really
  have no size in the export, and the external CSS only offers a generic `.ax_default{13px}` fallback — using it would
  be fabrication.

<h3 id="en-v0.3.0">Bug Fixes</h3>

- **`argbColor` treated transparent as opaque**: the old heuristic `a === 0 ? 1 : …` read `0x00FFFFFF` as opaque white.
  129 samples proved with zero exceptions that **the high byte is alpha** (`0x7f58a2cc` ↔ `opacity 0.4980392156862745`,
  exactly 127/255). It had **no call sites**, which is why nothing broke.
- **Two kinds of child layer were silently dropped — 52 layers in total**: ① the **state containers themselves**
  (`Axure:PanelDiagram`) were excluded for having no `location`/`size`, yet the three states of one panel have
  **different background colours**, so their backgrounds were lost; ② **repeater and table children**, which hang off
  `objects[]` rather than `objs[]` and were never visited. Now 670 == 670 with a zero-difference per-id diff.
- **`axureScriptIds` silently returned an empty map on wrong input** (a caller would conclude "this document has
  none"); it now throws with the correct usage.
- Handing a design link to the product-document tool now checks whether the id is a design first and points at the right
  tool (see 0.2.1).

<h3 id="en-v0.3.0">Chores</h3>

- Self-check **459 → 530 assertions**, all new ones using **synthetic fixtures** (**no 862 KB real export is committed**).
  Mutation tests prove the tripwires bite: removing any child-layer key turns 7 / 14 / 13 assertions red; disabling the
  audit turns 5 red.
- **`lanhu_verify_blocks` is not wired to prototype pages**: the front end for this prototype does not exist yet, so it
  would be **code with no real-machine evidence**; and the prototype canvas (1928×2962 absolute, non-responsive) is
  **not the same coordinate space** as the page under test. Aligning by **text content** once the page exists is the
  suggested route — the prototype text is already available and is the most reliable anchor.
- **One approach was tried and removed**: using the external CSS to fill in those 74 missing font sizes. All 251
  `#uNNN{font-size}` rules landed on widgets that already had one (the CSS is generated from `data.js`), so it was
  **zero benefit and the code was deleted**.
- **Narrative docs completed**: README (intro / quick start / what it can do / English overview) plus
  `docs/产品文档.md`, `docs/读稿.md`, `docs/验收.md` (which now explains **why prototype pages are not wired into
  verification**) and `docs/CLI与开发.md` all cover the new capability and its limits.
- **Policy: self-referential counts are not hard-coded in prose** — a tripwire can guard how many assertions
  *selfcheck* has, but not how many a tripwire itself has (that is only known once it finishes). Prose now states
  **what a tripwire guards** instead of a number, with an assertion preventing the number from creeping back.
- Ideas continue to be absorbed from [`dsphper/lanhu-mcp`](https://github.com/dsphper/lanhu-mcp) (MIT), **independently
  implemented**.

**Full Changelog**: [v0.2.1...v0.3.0](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.2.1...v0.3.0)
